ops.text: We keep $B$ fixed in entries rather than proportional to the prompt length $n$: for attention-ranked eviction the budget that matches the full cache has been measured to grow only as $n^{0.43}$ (AlloKV [⟦new.A1⟧]), so a proportional budget would mainly inflate the cache of the longest prompts.

new_bib.text: Ilona Sadowska, Fraser Mowat, Tomasz Wierzbicki, and Kirsty Ballantyne, “How much cache does a longer prompt need? Allometric budgets for KV-cache eviction,”. arXiv preprint, 2026.
